name: Healing The Nation
overview: Scripture reveals that true healing and blessing for a nation come from serving the LORD and remaining faithful to His commands, as seen in Exodus 23:25 where God promises to remove sickness from among His people. The Psalms affirm that a nation blessed by God is one whose people are chosen and who remember His benefits, including healing the brokenhearted (Psalms 33:12, 103:2, 147:3). Isaiah 41:10 encourages believers not to fear, for God strengthens and upholds them, demonstrating His sustaining power over a nation’s trials. Deuteronomy 18:9 warns against adopting the abominations of other nations, highlighting the importance of holiness in maintaining God’s favor and healing.
